reason: Lebanon's official time stayed UTC+2 until the night of 29/30 March 2023 (cabinet decision announced 2023-03-27 by caretaker PM Mikati, L'Orient Today), while tzdata 2023c+ (2026e) records UTC+3 from 2023-03-26 00:00 because it reverted to the regular rule to model the 'two time zones' chaos. Day strings are UTC dates of the affected samples (2023-03-25 22:00 UTC to 2023-03-29 22:00 UTC).
